about: All fork work in flight. Nodes carry the handoff: every node not done/parked has a 'next' step a cold session can pick up without chat history. WORK_LEDGER.md is the logbook of finished work.
rules: Never delete a node. Finished -> 'done'; abandoned -> 'parked' with the reason in 'next'.
Every node not 'done' or 'parked' must have a concrete 'next' step that anyone could pick up cold.
'needs' lists ids this node waits on; keep it acyclic.
Update 'status', 'next', and 'updated' in the same commit as the work, and at the end of every working session.
Run python3 .agents/check_tracking.py before committing changes here or to the ledger.

nodes.title: Identify ragesaq's printer model and confirm its wireless channel (BLE vs classic-BT SPP)
nodes.next: Done. nodes.title: Implement BleTransport behind INiimbotTransport in Niimbot.Net
nodes.next: Branch from upstream/main. Target hardware: ragesaq's B1 Pro (id 4097, 300 dpi, 567 px, B1 series - confirm which print task id 4097 maps to; 300 dpi path proven by D11_H). Per D-005: MacBleTransport in Niimbot.Net, pure-C# CoreBluetooth interop (libobjc P/Invoke, runtime delegate classes via objc_allocateClassPair + [UnmanagedCallersOnly], libdispatch serial queue), guarded by OperatingSystem.IsMacOS(). GATT: service e7810a71-73ae-499d-8c15-faa9aef0c3f2 / characteristic bef8d6c9-9c21-4c9e-b632-bd58c1009f9f, fallback: long-UUID service with NOTIFY + WRITE_NO_RESPONSE. Subscribe notifications, write-without-response, reassemble 55 55 ... AA AA frames across notifications. macOS quirk: connect by device name; app needs NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription in Info.plist (Pack-MacApp.sh). Unit-test frame reassembly with a replay transport. Dev loop: ragesaq's Mac + B1 Pro is the test rig; hardware verification doubles as the catalogue verification report for the B1 Pro.
